structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions
Licensure of the Practice of Funeral Service, Funeral Directors and Embalmers

law.catch_line: Immunity from liability for services after organ and tissue donation
law.text: Unless such act, decision, or omission resulted from bad faith or malicious intent, any funeral service establishment, funeral service licensee, crematory, or registered crematory that receives a body following donation of organs, tissues, or eyes shall be immune from civil liability for any failure to restore such decedent's form or features in a manner acceptable for viewing prior to the final disposition of the remains.
